newsitem.title: USA: Corning to build 2nd fiber optics plant.
newsitem.headline: Corning to build 2nd fiber optics plant.

text.p: Corning Inc., said Monday it will build a second U.S. plant to make optical fiber in North Carolina.

Construction on the plant, which is expected to cost "several hundred million dollars" should begin in 1997, Corning said. The plant is to be located near Midland, N.C., about 17 miles east of Charlotte. Production is expected to begin in 1999, Corning said.
Corning already operates the world's largest optical fiber plant, which is located in Wilmington and is in the midst of a $250 million expansion.
Corning said it expects to double optical fiber production in the next four years.
Corning's stock closed Monday at $37.625, down 12.5 cents, on the New York Stock Exchange.
